limitations: This profile requires macOS on Apple Silicon and UTM 5 or newer.
UTM shared networking has no port forwarding: open the guest's DHCP address.
UTM imports the disks into its bundle; it does not modify the immutable source images.
One vCPU: linux-libre's arm64 configuration has no SMP.
machine.name: utm-virt-arm64-devbox

logs.description: follow the Theia and sshd logs

ssh.description: ssh to the VM as the devbox user

DEVBOX_PASSWORD.description: Password of the login user, for SSH.

DEVBOX_USER.description: Login user for Theia's terminal and SSH; not root.
